form.label: Striim Application Monitor
form.description: Monitor Striim applications status and metrics from mon command output

search.query: index=striim_metrics sourcetype=_json $time_picker$ | spath output.striimApplications{}.statusChange | search "output.striimApplications{}.statusChange"=RUNNING | stats dc(eval(if("output.striimApplications{}.statusChange"=RUNNING, 1, null()))) as count | fields count

index=striim_metrics sourcetype=_json $time_picker$ | spath output.striimApplications{}.statusChange | search "output.striimApplications{}.statusChange"=STOPPED | stats dc(eval(if("output.striimApplications{}.statusChange"=STOPPED, 1, null()))) as count | fields count

index=striim_metrics sourcetype=_json $time_picker$ | spath output.striimApplications{}.statusChange | search "output.striimApplications{}.statusChange"=CREATED | stats dc(eval(if("output.striimApplications{}.statusChange"=CREATED, 1, null()))) as count | fields count
index=striim_metrics sourcetype=_json $time_picker$ | spath output.striimApplications{}.fullName | stats dc("output.striimApplications{}.fullName") as total_count | fields total_count

index=striim_metrics sourcetype=_json $time_picker$ | spath output.striimApplications{} | mvexpand "output.striimApplications{}" | rename "output.striimApplications{}.fullName" as "Application Name", "output.striimApplications{}.statusChange" as "Status", "output.striimApplications{}.rate" as "Rate", "output.striimApplications{}.numServers" as "Servers", "output.striimApplications{}.latestActivity" as "Latest Activity" | fields "Application Name", "Status", "Rate", "Servers", "Latest Activity" | sort - "Status"

index=striim_metrics sourcetype=_json $time_picker$ | spath output.striimApplications{}.statusChange | mvexpand "output.striimApplications{}.statusChange" | rename "output.striimApplications{}.statusChange" as status | stats count by status

index=striim_metrics sourcetype=_json $time_picker$ | spath output.striimApplications{}.statusChange | mvexpand "output.striimApplications{}.statusChange" | rename "output.striimApplications{}.statusChange" as Status | stats count as "Total Count" by Status | eval "Percentage"=round((count/sum(count))*100,2)."%"
index=striim_metrics sourcetype=_json $time_picker$ | stats count by _time | timechart count(eval(count))
